msgs.what: A criterion dropdown and one line of text under the scorecard.
The dashboard attaches the current plan question's id.
Enqueues `ScorecardNoteAdded` with a fresh uuid as the note id.
Empty text or a criterion outside the seven report criteria is dropped silently. Otherwise the note joins the scorecard with `source: "interviewer"`, no quote and no quality.
The whole scorecard is re-sent, so every tab of the session sees the note.
The note appears under its criterion prefixed *you:*. There is no optimistic insert: the note shows only once the round trip completes.
